project_type: Full-stack: Next.js 14 App Router (TypeScript + Tailwind) frontend + Python 3.11 FastAPI/Celery backend (backend/). Step 2 replaces the prototype's react-force-graph-3d with a custom React Three Fiber / Three.js WebGL engine and adds real-time WebSocket graph diffs.
build_system: Frontend: bun (via mise; npm/node are NOT on PATH, use bun). Backend: uv (Python 3.11). node_modules already installed. Add new frontend deps with `bun add`. Add backend deps by editing backend/pyproject.toml then `uv sync`.
test_framework: Frontend: NO test runner is configured yet. Add `bun test` (bun's built-in Jest-like runner) for pure-logic unit tests (store diff-apply, free-list, scoring->visual mapping). For a headless canvas-mount smoke test use a jsdom/WebGL-stub approach or Playwright against `next start` (Playwright is available as a Kiro power). Backend: pytest with FastAPI TestClient; fakes live in backend/tests/conftest.py (InMemory* stores). Use TestClient's websocket_connect for WS tests.
build_command: Frontend: `bun run build` (next build). Backend: `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest`.
test_command: Frontend: `bun test` (new unit tests) + `bun run lint`. Backend: `cd backend && uv run pytest -q`.
verification_instructions: 1) `bun run lint` clean except the two PRE-EXISTING NetworkGraph.tsx warnings (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps at ~415, no-img-element at ~635) IF that file still exists; ideally NetworkGraph.tsx is removed/replaced so those warnings disappear. 2) `bun run build` succeeds. 3) `bun test` passes new frontend unit tests. 4) Headless canvas-mount smoke passes (scene initializes without throwing). 5) backend: `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run mypy .`, `uv run pytest` all clean. Frame rate / visual correctness / live Redis+WS end-to-end CANNOT be validated in-sandbox and must be flagged for the user's real browser+GPU and managed infra.
setup_instructions: Frontend deps already installed in node_modules; add R3F/three-ecosystem deps with `bun add` (see FEAT-001). Backend: `cd backend && uv sync` restores the venv; add `redis`/`websockets` deps by editing pyproject.toml (redis>=5.0 is ALREADY a dependency). Do NOT background `next dev` or `docker compose up` (sandbox guard blocks it, Step 1 hit this) - use `next start` in bounded foreground or direct tests.
environment_constraints: Sandbox: OPEN_INTERNET, so `bun add` and `uv sync` package installs work. BUT rootless podman container networking is broken (Step 1 finding): you CANNOT stand up live Neo4j/Qdrant/Postgres/Redis or a live WS end-to-end loop in-sandbox. WebGL/60FPS CANNOT be measured headless. Design all WS + diff code to be unit-testable without live infra (in-memory/fake pub-sub, FastAPI TestClient websocket_connect). Node/npm are NOT on PATH; use `bun`. Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator publishes). Work stays on branch feat/step2-webgl-engine.
contribution_requirements: Conventional-commit style messages (feat:, fix:, chore:, docs:). Keep the deployed prototype working when BACKEND_URL and the new WS URL are unset: the frontend must still render from /api/graph (which itself falls back live-fetch -> /tmp -> mock). Real-time is an enhancement layered on top, never a hard dependency. Secrets via env only; never read/print/commit the gitignored .env.local Guardian key. Add .env.example placeholders for new vars.
key_patterns: Frontend: '@/' path alias -> repo root. Domain types in lib/types.ts (EconomicNode, EconomicEdge, GraphData, TopicCorrelation). Data hook lib/hooks/useApiData.ts:useGraphData() fetches GET /api/graph (returns {nodes, links, correlations, dataSource}). The 3D page is app/network/page.tsx which renders <NetworkGraph graphData={...}/>. Design system: charcoal #0a0a0a/#1a1a1a/#2a2a2a, lime #a3e635, emerald #4ade80, beige #d4c5a9, Inter font; utility classes glass/glass-premium/glass-strong in app/globals.css; category colors domestic=#22c55e international=#3b82f6 economic=#f59e0b political=#ef4444. Backend: FastAPI app factory create_app() in backend/app/main.py includes routers; deps injected via app.dependency_overrides for tests (backend/app/routers/deps.py get_read_store). Graph read/service in backend/app/services/graph_service.py; edge diff unit is naturally {source_article_id, target_article_id, weight, relationship, direction} (ScoredEdge). Ingestion task backend/app/tasks/ingest.py:run_ingestion() is where a diff publish hook belongs. redis>=5.0 is ALREADY in backend/pyproject.toml.

directory_structure: app/ = Next.js pages + API routes (app/network/page.tsx is the 3D page; app/api/graph/route.ts is the REST graph source). components/ = React components (NetworkGraph.tsx to replace; DailySummary, DataSourceBadge, LoadingSkeleton, NewsCard, PathwaySimulator, Sidebar, TopBar, TopicCorrelationsPanel). lib/ = types, hooks (useApiData), backend-client, news/ai/freshness utilities, mock-data. backend/ = Python FastAPI+Celery: app/main.py (factory+health), app/routers/ (graph, articles, deps), app/services/ (graph_service, correlations), app/tasks/ (celery_app, ingest), app/stores/ (neo4j/qdrant/postgres), app/config.py, tests/ (pytest + conftest fakes).
